metadata.short_desc: Web search and page reading with no API key, as LLM tools and a command.
metadata.desc: Adds two LLM tools to AstrBot, web search (keenable_web_search) and page reading (keenable_fetch_page), plus the /keenable command. Works out of the box with no signup or API key (rate-limited per IP); a free API key raises the limit. Maintained by Keenable.

api_key.hint: Leave empty to use the free keyless tier (rate-limited per IP: 1,000 requests per hour, 10 per second). A free key from https://keenable.ai/console raises the limit.

max_results.hint: 1-50. The model can ask for a different number on each call.

snippet_max_length.hint: 100-4000. Longer excerpts answer more questions directly but use more context.

enable_fetch.hint: When off, the model can only search. Reload the plugin after changing it.

fetch_max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by page reading
